seo.description: Amangati, Aman's first yacht, sails from Palma on 7 May 2027 with 47 suites on nine decks. Every published voyage to March 2028, day by day, and every suite's fare from US$31,500 per suite.

tagline: Forty-seven suites, an Aman Spa at sea, and a marina at the waterline.
answer: Amangati is the first yacht from Aman at Sea, the new sea-going arm of Aman. She is being built by T. Mariotti in Genoa to a design by Sinot Yacht Architecture & Design, with 47 suites across nine decks, each with a private terrace. Her maiden voyage leaves Palma de Mallorca on 7 May 2027 for Nice; she spends the summer of 2027 in the Mediterranean, crosses the Atlantic in November and winters in the Caribbean. Aman at Sea publishes 48 voyages of 5 to 13 nights, with fares per suite for the whole voyage from US$31,500.

overview: Amangati is Aman's first yacht and the start of Aman at Sea. She is under construction at T. Mariotti in Genoa, designed by Sinot Yacht Architecture & Design, and carries the calm of an Aman resort to sea: 47 suites across nine decks, every one with a private terrace and ceilings up to 2.5 metres.

The suites draw on the Japanese ryokan: timber tones, full-height windows and a Suite Host on call. They run from the 60 square metre Deluxe Suites to the 354 square metre Aman Suite at the stern, reached by its own lift, with a massage room, a sauna and a terrace whirlpool. Many suites connect to make two and three bedrooms.

Aboard are four restaurants, among them Akari for washoku and an omakase, Hiori for teppanyaki, the Aman Grill and Alira for all-day Mediterranean cooking, plus The Jazz Club after Aman New York's, a cigar lounge and a cinema. The Aman Spa takes most of a deck, with eight treatment suites on the sea, a hammam, a banya and a two-storey Japanese garden. A heated 16-metre infinity pool sits high above the water, and at the stern the marina opens on two floating platforms.

She sails the Mediterranean from May 2027, from Spain and the French and Italian Rivieras to the Adriatic, the Greek islands and Turkey, crosses the Atlantic from Málaga in November, and winters in the Leeward, Windward and ABC islands and the Dominican Republic. Fares are per suite, for the whole voyage, in US dollars.

faqs: When does Amangati first sail?

Her maiden voyage leaves Palma de Mallorca on 7 May 2027 and arrives in Nice on 13 May. She spends the summer of 2027 in the Mediterranean, crosses the Atlantic from Málaga in November, and winters in the Caribbean.
How many suites does Amangati have?
47, in six types from the Deluxe Suite (about 61 square metres) to the 354 square metre Aman Suite, every one with a private terrace.
Who built and designed Amangati?
She is under construction at T. Mariotti in Genoa, Italy, designed by Sinot Yacht Architecture & Design.
How much does an Amangati voyage cost?

Aman at Sea publishes a fare for each suite type on each voyage, per suite for the whole voyage, in US dollars. The lowest published today is US$31,500. Every voyage's fares are under Dates and rates on this page.
What is included in the fare?

Your suite and Suite Host, laundry and pressing, all-day dining at Alira, in-suite breakfast, non-alcoholic drinks and beer, the fitness studio, pools, marina and water toys, Starlink Wi-Fi and all onboard gratuities.
Where does Amangati sail?

Mediterranean Spain, the French and Italian Rivieras, Sicily and Malta, the Adriatic, the Greek islands and Turkey in 2027, then an Atlantic passage and the Leeward, Windward and ABC islands and the Dominican Republic in winter 2027 to 2028.
What are the restaurants on Amangati?

Four restaurants: Akari (washoku and omakase), Hiori (teppanyaki), the Aman Grill and Alira (all-day Mediterranean), with a private dining room for ten, in-suite dining, The Jazz Club and a cigar lounge.
Is there a spa on Amangati?
The Aman Spa has eight ocean-facing treatment suites with terraces and whirlpools, a hammam, a banya, a medi-spa, a beauty lounge, a yoga deck with two sea pools, and a two-storey Japanese garden.
Can families sail on Amangati?
Yes. There is a Youth Lounge for ages six to 15, and many suites connect into two- and three-bedroom suites.
What are the booking terms?
A 25% deposit at booking, with the balance due 150 days before departure. Cancellation charges rise from 15% of the fare more than 150 days out to 100% inside 60 days.
Can Amangati be chartered?
Yes. Aman at Sea offers the whole yacht for private charters and events, with custom itineraries.
